title: Prove the all-width kind B frame-swap removal criterion (no κ)
body:
## Result and scope

This package proves the **kind B removal criterion at every address width** in the formal frame game. For a nonplain part `y=WD+cW gamma`, an admissible removing call T removes the part exactly when **T exchanges both term frames and c is +1 or -1**. The hypotheses are gamma free, c nonzero rational, `level(WD)=level(TW)=2`, and `W gamma` outside the first-call frame PD.

[PR #7629](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7629) supplied finite evidence and asked for a proof of frame-swap sufficiency. This package proves necessity as well, at arbitrary width. Exchanging only one frame is insufficient. The proof forces a nonzero target coefficient at each endpoint, then constructs an even alternating cycle and gives every free preparation needed for removal.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c3b229d0788d6e980f75cbaabe07287899263a2/research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c3b229d0788d6e980f75cbaabe07287899263a2/research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c3b229d0788d6e980f75cbaabe07287899263a2/research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal/verify.py) and [scope record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c3b229d0788d6e980f75cbaabe07287899263a2/research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal/TASK.json). The kind A finishing and removal results in [PR #7649](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7649) and [PR #7677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7677) concern a different placement of gamma. They do not classify this kind B part.

**No new kappa**, native supplier or selected-assumption discharge is claimed. All five assumptions and [selected PR #7000](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7000) remain unchanged. This completes the [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19703259) on the narrowed formal-frame question of `complex-rank-shape-decoder`. It does not classify finishing, joint decoding or a general two-in-five program.

## Evidence and reproduction

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.16 checks passed on macOS arm64. A binary row-matrix checker enumerates all 10752 three-bit free elements and all 48 admissible removing calls. After 768 plain cases are excluded, it covers **479232 part/call pairs**. For 478720 pairs, a target coefficient is absent from every available column. For the other 512 pairs, complete cyclic-span checks give exactly the two allowed signs. The cycle lengths are two, four and eight; every positive has its explicit alternating relation checked.

The five tested coefficients {1,-1,2,1/2,-2/3} give 2396160 coefficient contracts. There are 128 distinct removable parts at each sign. That finite 128-part count belongs to the predecessor; the new result is the arbitrary-width theorem. Another route runs full span checks for 150 wider cases, including free conjugations that mix a core coordinate with a spare bit. Five boundary controls and two rational-solver controls pass.

Package metadata, committed bytes, executable modes, source ancestry, the official seven-file export and its integrity check passed. An optimized read-only export replay passed without Git or a usable PATH, with all eight payload/manifest hashes and modes unchanged. No external run-time input is used. The proof and README were rendered with GitHub Markdown and checked.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B -O research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/kind-b-frame-swap-removal --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected status markers:

```text
PASS_KIND_B_FRAME_SWAP_REMOVAL
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44260534367/job/134652498974) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Predecessor scientific replays, the selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Credit and remaining obligations

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Jacob Sussman (@jacobalansussman) defined kind B removal, supplied the finite evidence and posed the frame-exchange question in [PR #7629](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7629), [exact source](https://github.com/jacobalansussman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c2a2131e7dba35f9396b16588e125a7e8b5fab8e/research/complex-m3-shared-call-finish-or-remove/README.md). Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the related coset method in [PR #7649](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7649), [exact proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f642d2740265a61f8ac64b3a087f0118382c56e3/research/kind-a-last-call-coset/README.md). Ali Romman's kind A removal result is [PR #7677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7677), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2bb938975cf34de19d1e1db820f4c9b42c486cb4/research/kind-a-removability-coset/PROOF.md). The source's original geometry includes [PR #4628](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4628) and [PR #4743](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4743). The new verifier uses binary row matrices. New work is Apache-2.0.

The next question is whether these single-part cancellations can be used jointly while preserving both targets and shared preparation constraints. Pauli phases, native execution, precision, restoration and the complete signed physical invoice remain open. Free formal combinations are not a priced physical decoder. Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Live open/closed PR and Discussion overlap was checked; sparse local notes and unpublished work remain coverage limits.
